pricing: FACT (official pricing page): Starter $18/mo, Publisher $29/mo, Business $199/mo (billed yearly; member-count scaled). 14-day free trial. Custom/enterprise tier with SLA. No payment fees — upgrade/downgrade/cancel anytime.
problem: Writers and publishers are sharecroppers on ad-driven platforms and VC-backed tools that take 10-30% of revenue and can be acquired or enshittified
revenueEvidence: FACT (live public metrics, ghost.org/about, fetched Sep 2026): ARR $11,099,649 ($924,970/mo run-rate), 2.92% net churn, 30,579 active customers, 9B requests/mo. FACT (founder/press): $1.5M (Mar 2020) -> $3.3M+ (2021, Adweek); profitable every year since 2013; '$136M generated: $36M hosting revenue + $100M publisher platform revenue' (John O'Nolan). Non-profit; $8.2M+ raised from customers for 0% equity; zero outside investment.
sources: Ghost about page with live metrics (primary): https://ghost.org/about
Ghost 6.0 changelog: $100M earned by indie publishers (primary, Aug 2025)
status: Active (non-profit foundation; legally cannot be bought or sold)
teamSize: Dozens, fully remote since 2013 across 5 continents / 16 nationalities (named team list on about page; exact headcount UNKNOWN)
technology: FACT: open-source core, MIT-licensed, 55,072 GitHub stars, 100M+ installs; self-host or Ghost(Pro) managed hosting; 8,000+ integrations; custom themes. Exact language/framework stack UNKNOWN (not verified in reviewed sources).
valueProposition: Independent publishing platform: website + newsletter + paid memberships with 0% fees — you own audience, brand, data, and billing
weaknesses: Non-profit structure caps fundraising optionality; member-count-scaled pricing can jump steeply (Publisher $29 -> Business $199); competes with free Substack + VC-subsidized Beehiiv advances; educator/course features thinner than Kajabi/Podia
zeroDollarFeasibility: YES — Kickstarter pre-sales funded the build; open-source contributions scale development beyond payroll; hosting revenue funds everything since
aiUsage: Supporting: 'Optimize your site for AI search' (changelog Jul 2026), native analytics, translations. AI is distribution-adjacent, not core to the product.
category: Publishing / Newsletter-education — blogs, newsletters, paid memberships
complexity: MEDIUM (publishing + newsletters + Stripe memberships + multi-tier access)
